Overview Features Location Finance

Greenbelt Living with Nature on Your Doorstep

Web Ref. RL66819
Land size 400.00 m²
Floor size 178.00 m²
Monthly Bond Repayment
R42,930.33
EXCLUSIVE MANDATE

Perfectly positioned on one of Aan de Wijnlanden's sought-after greenbelt stands, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers a rare combination of privacy, tranquillity and uninterrupted views across the estate's natural surroundings.

From the moment you enter, you are welcomed by a charming landscaped courtyard garden, creating a warm and inviting first impression. The home features light-filled open-plan living spaces with high-volume exposed trusses, a stylish kitchen with a gas stove and seamless flow to the enclosed braai room where large stacking doors open towards the greenbelt beyond.

The spacious main bedroom enjoys direct access to the garden and picturesque views over the conservation area, while two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed family bathroom. Designed for comfortable everyday living, the home also benefits from a solar geyser, helping to reduce electricity consumption.

One of the standout features of this property is its exceptional position along the greenbelt, where residents can enjoy abundant birdlife and the unique sight of springbok grazing in the neighbouring conservation area of De Wijnlanden. It is a setting that offers a true connection with nature while still enjoying the convenience of estate living.

Property Features:
3 Bedrooms
2 Bathrooms (main en-suite)
Open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with gas stove
Enclosed braai room with stacking doors
Landscaped courtyard garden
Solar geyser
Greenbelt frontage
Beautiful conservation area views
Single-level living

About Aan de Wijnlanden Lifestyle Estate

Aan de Wijnlanden is a secure lifestyle estate ideally situated between Stellenbosch and Somerset West, with easy access to Cape Town International Airport and major routes. The estate is renowned for its family-friendly atmosphere, excellent security, and beautiful natural surroundings.

Residents enjoy access to:

24-hour manned security and access control
Clubhouse and communal swimming pool
Tennis court and padel court
Walking and jogging trails
Children's parks and open green spaces
Crèche and preschool within the estate
Fibre connectivity throughout the estate

Whether you're looking to downscale, invest, or find the perfect family home, this greenbelt gem offers a lifestyle that is difficult to match.

Wake up to birdsong, enjoy sunset views across the conservation area, and experience estate living at its finest.
